seoDescription: Interior design services from Reid Design LLC. In-home consultations, full room design, styling, and shopping support. Plainfield and Greater Indianapolis.
heroHeadline: From a $150 consultation to a full room reveal
heroSubhead: Everything I do is priced openly. Pick the tier that fits where you are.
servicesListSubhead: Most interior designers don't publish their prices. I do. So you know what to expect before you ever pick up the phone.

builderRealtorSection.headline: Builder & Realtor Partnerships

children.text: [NEW per audit, softer framing] If you're a builder, realtor, or contractor in the Plainfield or Indianapolis area, I'd love to talk about how design support could help your clients. Whether it's finish selections for new construction, staging for listings, or move-in styling packages, scope and pricing get worked out per project or packaged per home.

builderRealtorSection.forBuildersText: Finish selections, fixture packages, and design guidance for new construction.
builderRealtorSection.forRealtorsText: Staging for listings, move-in styling for buyers, and a design referral partner for your clients.
builderRealtorSection.forContractorsText: Design-side coordination for renovation projects. I handle the aesthetic decisions so you can focus on the build.

serviceAreaSection.headline: Travel for Out-of-Area Projects
serviceAreaSection.description: Reid Design serves the Plainfield and Indianapolis area at no extra travel cost. For homes further out, a small travel fee covers the drive time and is always quoted upfront before any work begins.

finalCtaSubhead: Reach out and we'll figure it out together. No pressure, no commitment, just a real conversation about your space.
note: Service cards populate automatically from all service documents in displayOrder. Travel fee tiers pull from siteSettings.travelFees.
